question: Find the surface area of a sphere whose diameter is equal to 64 cm.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Diameter** (d) = 64 cm ⇒ **Radius** (r) = 32 cm.

**Surface Area** of sphere = 4πr².

Calculation: 4 × π × (32)² = 4 × π × 1024 = 4096π cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 4096π cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Diameter** of the **sphere** (d) = 64 cm

**Formula Used:**

**Radius** (r) = d ÷ 2

**Surface Area** (A) = 4πr²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d376c4a7f93084ffa20b6bf4e4f9fb2f776a82860f286b83ce9ecc694494036.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ **Radius** (r) = 64 ÷ 2 = 32 cm

⇒ **Surface Area** = 4 × π × (32)²

⇒ **Surface Area** = 4 × π × 1024

⇒ **Surface Area** = 4096π cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 4096π cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Sphere

The amount of space inside a sphere is given by V = (4/3)πr³.

Surface Area of a Hemisphere

Curved Surface Area = 2πr² and Total Surface Area = 3πr².

Radius vs Diameter

The **radius** is exactly half of the **diameter** (r = d/2).</p
